failures.what_went_wrong: The agent identified the 4-year SPA non-compete and 18-month employment agreement restriction but failed to analyze enforceability risks or inconsistencies between the two provisions. It treated them as standalone facts without legal scrutiny.
failures.should_have: Applied a legal test for enforceability (e.g., reasonableness of duration, scope, and geographic reach) to the 4-year non-compete, benchmarked it against jurisdictional standards, and explicitly flagged the inconsistency with the 18-month restriction as a high-risk issue requiring harmonization.

failures.what_went_wrong: The agent correctly identified 11 March 2028 as a Saturday and adjusted the escrow release date to 12 March 2028 (Monday), but the rubric expected 13 March 2028. The discrepancy arose from misapplying the 'next Business Day' rule or miscalculating the day-of-week for 12 March 2028.
failures.should_have: Recomputed the adjusted escrow release date using a date calculator to verify the day-of-week for the proposed adjusted date (12 March 2028) and confirmed it was a Business Day under the document's definition. candidates.text: For every restrictive covenant, benchmark duration, scope, and geographic reach against jurisdictional standards and market norms. Flag deviations as high-risk enforceability concerns and recommend harmonization to the stricter standard if inconsistencies exist across related agreements.

When adjusting deadlines for Business Days, verify the day-of-week status of the proposed adjusted date using a date calculator. Recompute until the next valid Business Day is confirmed, and document the verification steps in the deliverable.

For every pair of inconsistent restrictive covenants, include a side-by-side comparison table with columns for: document source, clause wording, duration/scope/geographic reach, legal test for enforceability, benchmark against standards, risk rating, and recommended harmonization.

Before finalising deadline adjustments, reverse-compute the adjusted date to confirm it aligns with the document's Business Day definition. Use a date calculator to verify day-of-week status and cross-check against jurisdictional holidays.

For every deadline adjustment, document the original date, day-of-week status, Business Day definition applied, adjusted date, verification method, and legal consequence of missing the adjusted deadline.

For restrictive covenants, apply a two-step framework: (1) quote exact wording and benchmark against jurisdictional standards; (2) compare against related agreements for inconsistencies and recommend harmonization to the stricter standard unless operational constraints justify otherwise.
